spans.s:
And there is substitution of आ for the finals of मी 'to hurt', मि 'to scatter' and दी 'to decay' when the affix ल्यप् follows, as well as before those affixes which demand this substitution for the dipthong.

Terms: धातु-सिध्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) मी is shortened before a शित् affix.

Terms: shortening
